status: protocol-only; implementation and native invocation require coordinator acceptance

article.scope: Actual shaderc compilation and CPU interpretation; no shader execution. No outcome of this probe upgrades that scope.

sources.provenance_limit: Comparison definitions, not authenticated source identity of installed loader or drivers.

loader.changed_bytes_policy: Record mismatch and stop before CDLL; do not silently substitute a different library.

abi.calling_convention: ordinary Linux C via ctypes.CDLL; no varargs
abi.null_application_info: Vulkan 1.0 semantics; no second structure or version negotiation

environment.scope: system-path-only scoped probe, not untouched desktop environment or exhaustive hardware census
environment.helper_usage: Copy exact pinned helper unchanged; prepare_environment on exclusively owned fresh absolute nonsymlink temporary root, then validate_environment before spawning.
environment.limits: No explicit layers/extensions requested; implicit system layers and loader build-time discovery paths are not asserted absent. No private directory scans. Isolation helper is not a sandbox.

invocation.launch: Absolute current Python executable and frozen child path; argv only, no shell. Own Linux session/process group.
invocation.outputs: Fresh UUID directory, exclusive creation, STARTED receipt before spawn, raw stdout/stderr and terminal parent receipt; never reuse old summary.
required_metadata: parent and child process IDs where available
protocol and all Python source SHA256
requested and resolved loader path and actual SHA256
five-key isolation map and explicit base environment
ABI actual sizes, alignment and offsets
invocation.timeout_policy: Bounded parent wait; record timeout and attempt TERM then KILL on owned process group with bounded waits. Preserve partial trace. Do not claim crash-safe destructor or universal process cleanup.

call_protocol.trace: For each native call, flush a numbered attempt record BEFORE native entry and a matching returned record AFTER return. Counts distinguish attempted from returned calls; never infer completion from constants. No native addresses printed.
call_protocol.create: Exactly once, output handle initially NULL, allocator NULL. Nonzero VkResult: preserve signed result and known name if recognized; no enumerate/destroy. SUCCESS requires nonnull instance or PROTOCOL_ANOMALY.
call_protocol.count_query: Once after valid creation, initialized uint32 zero and NULL device array. Only SUCCESS permits consuming count. Error or unexpected positive result stops enumeration with its own category.
call_protocol.over_bound: COUNT_EXCEEDS_PROBE_BOUND; no allocation or fill; not driver failure.
call_protocol.fill: For count 1..64 allocate exactly count opaque handle slots initialized NULL; input count is capacity; exactly one fill call, no growth or retry.
call_protocol.fill_success_or_incomplete_guards: For BOTH VK_SUCCESS (0) and VK_INCOMPLETE (5), require returned count <= capacity and nonnull handles in every returned slot before reporting enumeration. Record count and nonnull facts only. Violations are PROTOCOL_ANOMALY. INCOMPLETE remains partial even when count is zero.
call_protocol.fill_other_results: Preserve exact VkResult; do not consume array or treat returned count as valid device count.
call_protocol.destroy: Finally exactly once only after SUCCESS with nonnull created instance, matching NULL allocator. Physical device handles need no separate destruction here. Log attempt and return. Abnormal kill/crash can prevent cleanup.

terminal_categories.SOURCE_PIN_MISMATCH: Protocol/source/helper or loader bytes changed from expected pins
terminal_categories.ENVIRONMENT_SETUP_FAILED: Fresh root or minimal environment validation failed
terminal_categories.LOADER_UNAVAILABLE: Pinned loader could not be opened/read/loaded; preserve exact reason
terminal_categories.LOADER_BINDING_FAILED: One of three required symbols could not be bound; no create call
terminal_categories.INSTANCE_CREATION_FAILED: Nonzero negative create VkResult; -9 INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER is scoped to this request/environment, not proof of no GPU
terminal_categories.ENUMERATION_FAILED: Negative count/fill VkResult, exact phase and code retained
terminal_categories.UNEXPECTED_RESULT: Unexpected nonnegative VkResult outside the allowed phase-specific results
terminal_categories.ENUMERATED_ZERO: Successful count query zero or successful bounded fill zero; record which phase
terminal_categories.ENUMERATED_NONZERO: Successful bounded fill and valid nonnull returned range; not proof of GPU or shader capability
terminal_categories.ENUMERATED_PARTIAL: VK_INCOMPLETE and valid bounded nonnull returned range; not complete device census
terminal_categories.COUNT_EXCEEDS_PROBE_BOUND: Successful count query above64; intentional bounded-probe limitation
terminal_categories.PROTOCOL_ANOMALY: Invalid success/null, capacity overrun report, null returned handle, inconsistent trace or missing required terminal evidence
terminal_categories.TIMEOUT: Parent deadline exceeded; partial trace and termination attempts retained
terminal_categories.CHILD_CRASH: Abnormal child exit with no valid complete report; record exact returncode without inferring signal from stderr text alone
terminal_categories.PYTHON_EXCEPTION: Unexpected Python exception, preserve traceback and attempted cleanup; not native success
terminal_categories.INTERRUPTED_OR_INCOMPLETE: Invocation lacks complete consistent terminal receipt; never consume as success

acceptance.negative_is_observation: A complete API failure report can be valid evidence of an obstacle, never a passed GPU test. Raw diagnostics remain archived, not silently discarded.
acceptance.consumer: Require matching UUID, source pins, raw hashes, exit/timeout metadata, phase-specific guards and consistent attempted/returned trace. Missing/interrupted evidence fails closed. Cleanup exceptions or incomplete destroy return cannot be labeled completed enumeration; retain any earlier observation as partial evidence.
acceptance.stop: Stop after this one child regardless of result. No device creation, queue/property query, shader/pipeline/buffer/surface/dispatch/rendering calls; no alternate API, installation, search expansion or retries.
acceptance.claim_limit: Loader availability is not device availability; enumerated devices may be software. No hardware census, performance, Vulkan conformance, driver authenticity or shader-execution claim.
